title: Tide Thyme Wellness: Massage and Recovery Studio in Sparks, NV
meta_description: A small massage and recovery studio in Sparks, Nevada. Deep tissue, prenatal, and sports recovery by appointment, seven days a week.
headline: An hour that gives you the week back.
subhead: A two room studio, no upsells, no rushing. Massage and recovery work booked online and kept on time.
services_heading: Booked by the hour, not the package.
services_intro: Every session is one on one. Nothing here requires a membership.

services.name: Deep tissue
services.description: Slow, firm work for the knots that come back every month.

services.name: Sports recovery
services.description: For training weeks and race weeks, with stretching built in.

services.name: Prenatal
services.description: Side lying and fully supported, from the second trimester on.

services.name: Swedish
services.description: Lighter pressure, full body, the one to book when you are just worn down.

services.name: Cupping add on
services.description: Added to any session for shoulders, low back, or calves.

services.name: 90 minute session
services.description: Any treatment, with the time to actually finish the work.

about_body: We left bigger spas to build something quieter. No front desk script, no membership pitch at the end of your hour.
Licensed in Nevada, twelve years between us, and the same two people every time you come in.

reviews.text: First place that listened to where it actually hurt instead of following a routine.
I have a desk job and a bad shoulder. Monthly here has done more than a year of stretching.
Calm, clean, and they start on time, which I cannot say for anywhere else I have been.
